title: Correct the attach · @sandmrk
prompt:
Correct the attached portrait with THREE anatomy and veil fixes only. The woman's face, her upward-left gaze, her hair and gold ornaments, the cupped hands, the ivory-gold gown, the astrological circle background, the golden dreamy light and the overall composition stay exactly the same.
the sheer ivory veil must hang DOWN over the lower half of her face: from the line across her nose it drapes over her mouth, lips, chin and jaw and down the front of her neck, all of it behind the translucent gauze — her lips and chin faintly visible through the fabric, softly veiled, never bare. Her eyes, brows and forehead stay fully uncovered above the veil's top edge. The veil still falls from her head down her back with its gold-embroidered border.
shorten her neck to a natural human length: the distance from her chin to her collarbones is short and ordinary, her head sits directly and naturally on her shoulders — no swan neck, no elongated neck, no raised or stretched throat.
her head is a natural size for her body: head height in correct proportion to her shoulders and torso, neither small nor large; skull, jaw and neck join anatomically correctly, the head's tilt matching the neck's axis.
the same delicate face with straight bangs, bright eyes looking up-left; the gold forehead chain with teardrop pendant; the gold butterfly hair ornament with long beaded chains; the carved gold armlet, the many thin gold bangles and the fine bead bracelet; both hands cupped open at the lower left with five natural fingers each; the ivory draped gown with gold borders and the belt medallion; the glowing golden zodiac circle behind her; the soft bloom and floating dust.
Negative: no bare mouth or chin, no veil band floating at the nose with bare skin below, no long neck, no small head, no large head, no changed face, no changed pose, no extra arms, no extra or fused fingers, no text.
Signature: the text "AI art gallery | @sandmrk" in Montserrat Regular, pure white, letter spacing +1.5px, text height 2% of image height, maximum width 25% of image width, centered horizontally at the bottom, its baseline 10% of image height above the bottom edge, no shadow, no outline, no glow, no background.
